Order → invoice → owner update

Fictional example, prepared to show the format of a deliverable. No client work, research, message sending or automation was performed by opening this page.

Fictional scenario: a confirmed website order for two items at $40 each. This is not a payable invoice.

Illustrative order summary
ReferenceINV-SAMPLE-001
Quantity × unit price2 × $40
Illustrative subtotal$80
Tax, fees and totalDetermined by the actual business’s configured billing rules

The planned trigger

A verified, confirmed order event from the client’s connected website. Repeated delivery of the same event should not create a second invoice.

Approval before automation

The business approves the sender account, invoice template, calculation rules and exact events allowed to send emails. If an event is incomplete or outside those rules, it is held for review.

Example email draft

Subject: Your invoice for order SAMPLE-001

Hello,
Thank you for your order. Your invoice would be attached here after the confirmed order details and billing rules have been checked.
Contact the business through its approved support channel if anything needs correction.

Example owner alert

“Order SAMPLE-001: invoice generated. Email status: [confirmed sent / pending / failed]. See the recorded result in your workspace.”

If a send fails

Record the failure, avoid reporting success and notify the owner or coordinator. Any retry must preserve the original invoice identity and avoid duplicate sending.

Current status: illustrative workflow only. Website events, invoice generation and outbound email are not connected on the Group website.
